description: Show detail on specified Direct Cost Item.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the Direct Cost Item.

id.description: Unique identifier of the Direct Cost Item. Use as the {id} path parameter to retrieve, update, or delete this item.

attachments.description: Files attached to the Direct Cost Item (for example, scanned invoices or receipts).

attachments_count.description: Number of files attached to the Direct Cost Item.

company.description: Company that owns the project this Direct Cost Item belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the Direct Cost Item was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when the Direct Cost Item was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null for active items.

description.description: Free-text description of the Direct Cost Item.

direct_cost_type.description: Category of the Direct Cost Item.

employee.description: Employee (project contact) associated with the Direct Cost Item.

id.description: Contact ID of the employee (references the project Contact record, not LoginInformation).

invoice_number.description: Vendor invoice number. Present only for invoice-type items; must be unique per vendor within the tool.

direct_cost_date.description: Date the direct cost was incurred, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

origin_data.description: Opaque third-party payload stored with the item for external-system integrations. Not interpreted by Procore.

origin_id.description: Identifier of this item in the originating external system; used to correlate synced records.

grand_total.description: Sum of all line item amounts on the Direct Cost Item, as a decimal string.

grand_total_with_tax.description: Sum of all line item amounts on the Direct Cost Item plus tax, as a decimal string.

line_items_count.description: Number of line items on the Direct Cost Item.

payment_date.description: Date the direct cost was paid, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

project.description: Project the Direct Cost Item belongs to.

received_date.description: Date the direct cost was received, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

status.description: Review/approval state of the Direct Cost Item.

synced.description: Whether the Direct Cost Item is linked to an external ERP/accounting system (has an origin ID or synced line items).

has_workflows.description: Whether the Direct Cost Item has an active workflow (approval) instance assigned.

terms.description: Agreed payment terms for the invoice (for example, Net 30).

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the Direct Cost Item was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

vendor.description: Vendor (company contact) billed on the Direct Cost Item.

vendor_id.description: Identifier of the vendor billed on the Direct Cost Item. Required for invoice-type items.

vendor_name.description: Display name of the vendor billed on the Direct Cost Item.

currency_configuration.description: Multicurrency configuration for the Direct Cost Item. Values are meaningful only when object-level multicurrency is enabled.

currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency the item amounts are recorded in.

currency_exchange_rate.description: Exchange rate used to convert the item currency to the project base currency, as a decimal string.

base_currency_iso_code.description: ISO 4217 code of the project's base currency.

tax_breakdown.description: Header-level tax rollup. Always included on the response as an object, including when Direct Cost taxes are disabled. tax_details is an empty array when no stored tax details are returned. Presence...

subtotal.description: Sum of line-item amounts before tax

tax_total.description: Total tax across all line items

grand_total.description: subtotal plus tax_total. Equals the top-level grand_total_with_tax.

tax_details.description: One entry per component tax code rate that produced tax on this Direct Cost. Group entries by selected_tax_code_id and selected_tax_code_rate_key.

line_items.description: Line items belonging to the Direct Cost Item.

id.description: Unique identifier of the line item.

amount.description: Bottom-line monetary amount of the line item, as a decimal string.

company.description: Company that owns the project this line item belongs to.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the line item was created, in ISO 8601 format.

description.description: Free-text description of what the line item covers.

extended_type.description: How the line item amount is derived. `calculated` means amount = quantity × unit_cost; `manual` means the amount was entered directly.

line_item_type.description: Cost category (line item type) assigned to this line item.

origin_data.description: Opaque third-party payload stored with the line item for external-system integrations. Not interpreted by Procore.

origin_id.description: Identifier of this line item in the originating external system; used to correlate synced records. Null when not synced.

funding_rule_id.description: ID of the funding rule associated with this line item

position.description: Sort order of the line item within its parent Direct Cost Item.

quantity.description: Quantity of the described item, as a decimal string. Multiplied by unit_cost when extended_type is calculated.

tax_code_id.description: Identifier of the tax code applied to this line item.

total_amount.description: Bottom-line monetary amount of the line item, as a decimal string. Equals quantity × unit_cost when extended_type is calculated, or the entered value when manual. Currently identical to `amount` an...

extended_amount.description: Bottom-line monetary amount of the line item, as a decimal string. Equals quantity × unit_cost when extended_type is calculated, or the entered value when manual. Currently identical to `amount` an...

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit of the described item, as a decimal string.

uom.description: Unit of measure for the described item (for example, Lbs, cubic feet). Must be a value from the company's Units of Measure list.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the line item was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

ref.description: Client-supplied reference passed on create to correlate the request with the response. Not persisted.
